title: WhimTex clipboard layer JSON, version 1
description: 1 MiB maximum; 128 total layers, 8 nested groups, 16 total shaders, 16 linked images. IDs must be unique, targets must resolve without cycles. Canvas at most 16,777,216 pixels. A Drawing layer with url downloads one image (PNG or JPEG, at most 64 MB and 16 megapixels) after a confirmation. Unity also checks cross-field and shader constraints.

gradientStops.description: Stops must have strictly increasing times.

position.description: Canvas-pixel offset; default [0,0], X right, Y up.

scale.description: Each absolute component must be at least 0.00001.

code.description: Self-contained ApplyFX HLSL. Declare values with // @param. No #, backslashes or asset GUIDs. At most 32 parameters.

url.description: Absolute http(s) link to a PNG or JPEG. It is downloaded on paste after a confirmation, the layer keeps the source resolution, and its transform scale is fitted to the canvas, so do not set transform.scale.
